'''Terlyn's daughter''' was a one of [[Terlyn]]'s children in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. After her [[Terlyn's husband|father]] was killed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]], they desperately sought a [[starport visa]] to leave the planet.<ref name="The Sith Lords" />
